summary: Fix false degraded restoration after temporary Wi-Fi-off by making network setting restore idempotent and treating Android proxy port 0 as inactive.

capability_impact.detail: No new capability. Corrects sentinel interpretation and exact-restore verification for existing temporary network leases.

architecture_impact.reason: Existing Network Mutation Guard remains sole owner; no new daemon, registry, scheduler or state store.

mcp_parity.detail: No MCP primitive, schema, adapter or owner-surface change.

live_evidence.observed_issue: Maxit live read succeeded but wrapper exited non-zero because Android rejected direct writes of unchanged empty proxy settings and port=0 was misclassified as active.
live_evidence.restored_state: Wi-Fi and proxy settings independently verified equal to pre-run snapshot before patch.

rollback: Revert this commit; previous guard behavior returns, including the false degraded sentinel case.
